in_marathi.name: Avanish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Destroyer of Illusions
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avanish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avanish is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ava' meaning 'away' and 'nis' meaning 'to destroy'. This name signifies the removal of ignorance and the revealing of truth. In Hindu mythology, Avanish is also the name of a god associated with the destruction of illusions and the revelation of the true nature of reality.
